job.title: Integration Engineer
job.description:
About the role 

Integration Engineer We are seeking an experienced AIS Integration Engineer to develop, test, implement, and support enterprise integrations across on-premises, SaaS, and cloud applications.

Key Responsibilities
  • Develop and maintain integrations using Azure Integration Services.
  • Build Azure Function Apps, Logic Apps, APIs, and Azure Service Bus solutions.
  • Develop data mappings, transformations, and error-handling processes.
  • Support the DEV → SIT → UAT → PRD development and release lifecycle.
  • Troubleshoot integration issues and provide production support.
  • Collaborate with the AIS Integration Lead, developers, architects, and project teams.
  • Follow established security, development, testing, and deployment standards.
Essential Skills & Experience
  • 5+ years’ experience in software and integration development.
  • Experience with AIS / enterprise integration platforms.
  • Strong Azure API Management and Azure Service Bus experience.
  • .NET / C# development experience.
  • Experience with Azure Functions and Logic Apps.
  • Good knowledge of REST APIs, HTTP, JSON/XML, and messaging concepts.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps, CI/CD and SDLC.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Desirable
  • Event Grid / event-driven integration
  • Azure Key Vault
  • Azure Monitor / Application Insights
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC)

job.title: D365 F&O Architect
job.description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced D365 F&O Solution Architect to join our client's team on a 6-month contract.

In this role, you will be responsible for designing and delivering effective Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations solutions that align with business objectives and strategic technology roadmaps. You will work closely with business stakeholders, project managers, business analysts and technical teams to translate business requirements into scalable, secure and sustainable technology solutions.

You will also provide architectural leadership, evaluate solution options and ensure that solutions are aligned with enterprise architecture standards and best practices.
Key Responsibilities
  • Lead the solution architecture and design of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations implementations.
  • Work closely with business and technical stakeholders to understand project objectives, requirements and constraints.
  • Evaluate and recommend technology solutions, considering cost of ownership, scalability, security, performance and long-term business value.
  • Develop and document solution architectures across business, application, information and technology domains.
  • Facilitate workshops and design discussions to align stakeholders on preferred solution approaches.
  • Ensure solution development aligns with approved architecture designs, enterprise standards and strategic technology roadmaps.
  • Provide technical leadership, guidance and mentoring to project teams.
  • Contribute to enterprise architecture frameworks, standards, reference architectures and technology roadmaps.
  • Identify opportunities to improve IT processes, technology capabilities and operational efficiency.
  • Ensure solutions address operational requirements, including maintainability, monitoring, resilience and high availability.
Key Requirements
  • At least 5 years of experience designing and implementing Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations solutions.
  • Proven experience taking ownership of solution architecture, design decisions and implementation outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of solution architecture across business, application, information and technology domains.
  • Experience evaluating and selecting technology solutions and components to meet business and technical requirements.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to facilitate workshops across business and technical teams.
  • Experience working across various software development methodologies.
  • Ability to translate complex business requirements into practical, scalable and sustainable technology solutions.
Desirable
  • Experience or certification in enterprise architecture frameworks and notations such as TOGAF and ArchiMate.
  • Experience developing enterprise architecture principles, standards, reference architectures and strategic technology roadmaps.
Apply Now If you are an experienced D365 F&O Solution Architect looking for your next contract opportunity, we would love to hear from you. Apply now or get in touch to discuss the opportunity further.

job.title: Senior Power BI Engineer
job.description:
We are seeking an experienced Power BI Engineer with strong technical capabilities and the ability to work closely with business stakeholders to deliver data-driven insights and reporting solutions.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, strong SQL skills, and the ability to translate business requirements into effective data models, dashboards, and analytics solutions. Experience working on AI-related initiatives or integrating AI capabilities into data and reporting solutions will be highly regarded.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, and data visualisations to support business decision-making.
  • Build and optimise data models, datasets, and reporting solutions using Power BI and Microsoft Fabric.
  • Write and optimise complex SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyse data from various sources.
  • Work closely with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements, define KPIs, and translate business needs into technical solutions.
  • Develop and maintain data transformation processes and ensure data accuracy, consistency, and performance.
  • Troubleshoot and optimise Power BI reports, data models, and queries to improve performance and usability.
  • Collaborate with technical teams and business users to deliver scalable, reliable, and user-friendly analytics solutions.
  • Explore opportunities to leverage AI and advanced analytics to improve reporting, insights, and business processes.
Key Skills and Experience
  • Strong hands-on experience developing Power BI reports, dashboards, and data models.
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric, including its data and analytics capabilities.
  • Strong SQL skills, including writing, troubleshooting, and optimising complex queries.
  • Ability to gather business requirements and communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working across both development and business-facing activities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on delivering actionable business insights.
  • Experience with AI, machine learning, generative AI, or AI-enabled analytics solutions will be highly regarded.

job.title: Business Solutions Administrator
job.description:
We are seeking a Business Solutions Administrator to support the administration, configuration and ongoing improvement of Salesforce within an established organisation.

Working closely with technical specialists, business stakeholders and external partners, you will support Salesforce implementation activities before transitioning into day-to-day platform administration. The role will suit someone with a hands-on approach to CRM systems, strong problem-solving skills and an interest in improving business processes through technology.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Administer and configure Salesforce, including user access, permissions, objects, fields, page layouts and platform settings.
  • Build and maintain Salesforce Flows, validation rules, reports, dashboards and other declarative functionality.
  • Translate business requirements into practical system configurations and enhancements, working with technical leads and implementation partners.
  • Support system testing, user acceptance testing, defect resolution and controlled releases.
  • Assist with data migration, cleansing, imports, validation and reconciliation to maintain data quality.
  • Provide day-to-day Salesforce administration and user support, investigating issues and coordinating technical escalations.
  • Maintain system documentation, configuration records and user guides, supporting training and platform adoption.
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows, automate manual processes and enhance system performance and usability.
About You: You are a proactive and detail-oriented business systems professional with experience supporting CRM platforms and a genuine interest in Salesforce. You enjoy working with stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into effective, sustainable solutions.

You will ideally bring:
  • Experience administering Salesforce or a comparable CRM or business application.
  • Knowledge of system configuration, user access, reporting and workflow automation.
  • Experience with testing, documentation, data management and change processes.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting and communication skills.
  • An understanding of data quality, privacy and information security.
  • A collaborative approach, with the ability to work independently and escalate complex technical issues when required.
Salesforce Certified Administrator certification is desirable, or you will be willing to achieve it within an agreed timeframe. Experience with Salesforce Flows, Platform App Builder, integrations or data migration will be highly regarded.
The Opportunity Join a collaborative team where you can contribute to business systems improvement, develop your Salesforce expertise and take ownership of the platform's ongoing administration.

A relevant IT or business systems qualification is advantageous. The successful candidate must have the right to work in Australia and be willing to complete a satisfactory National Police Check, with additional screening where applicable.

job.title: Senior Data Analyst
job.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Analyst to support a major HRIS transformation, with a strong focus on preparing, cleansing and migrating HR data into Workday.

This is a hands-on role suited to a data professional with experience across HR and payroll datasets, data migration and enterprise system implementations. You will work closely with HR, payroll, technical teams and implementation partners to ensure data is accurate, complete and ready for successful migration.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Analyse, profile and cleanse HR and payroll data across multiple source systems.
  • Develop source-to-target data mappings and transformation rules aligned with Workday data requirements.
  • Identify data gaps, resolve quality issues and validate datasets ahead of migration.
  • Support Workday data loads, mock conversions, reconciliation, UAT and payroll parallel testing.
  • Assist with cutover planning, production data validation and post-implementation support.
  • Facilitate workshops with business stakeholders to validate data and resolve discrepancies.
  • Maintain data documentation, governance standards and clear data ownership.
Skills & Experience:
  • 7+ years’ experience in data analysis, data migration or business analysis.
  • Experience delivering at least one end-to-end HRIS or ERP data migration.
  • Strong experience working with Workday and/or complex HR and payroll datasets is highly regarded.
  • Advanced Excel skills and strong SQL capability for data manipulation, reconciliation and validation.
  • Understanding of data mapping, transformation, data quality and relational databases.
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement, communication and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience with Workday data loads, EIBs, payroll parallel testing, Power BI or Python will be advantageous.

What's on offer?
  • $900 - $1,000 p/d
  • Inital 12-month contract
  • 3-4 days p/w in office
  • Nearby Melbourne CBS location

This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to a significant HR technology transformation, helping deliver high-quality data and a successful Workday implementation.
